summary: Full re-verification of the unified 'PDF وواتساب' share feature. Backend pytest suite (test_outbound_share_iter278.py) re-run: 20/20 PASS. Frontend deep test executed 7 flows via Playwright covering TemplatesManager WhatsApp tab (edit validation + save + restore), DocumentPrint WhatsApp preview (ready state, PDF+image thumbnail, message, normalized phone), cache-hit indicator (♻️), invalid phone handling with in-modal edit, superseded/draft/cancelled watermarks + superseded block, QuickPrintDialog on VehicleDetails page (button label 'PDF وواتساب' + preview modal reaches READY), audit strictness (only allowed events, all trace_ids prefixed 'tr-'). All flows PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: OutboundMessagesTab: variables helper shows format {{VAR}} while the module comment in TemplatesManager also uses {{VAR}} — consistent. Confirmed backend rejects unknown vars (server-side {'FOO'} → validation error 'متغيرات غير معروفة: FOO' surfaced in UI).
WhatsAppSharePreview: canShareFiles gated on navigator.canShare — correctly hides files button on desktop/headless. wa.me button falls back with text-only. Excellent honesty note preserved.
Backend routes_outbound.py: 20 tests cover template selection, superseded 409, fingerprint stability + tenant isolation, cache reuse, forbidden events 422, versioning/restore, and JWT enforcement.

DocumentPrint statusLabels correctly includes cancelled/superseded. Watermark rendered with .strong class for draft/cancelled/superseded. superseded correctly blocks share (400/409) and modal shows error state with no share buttons.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature complete and stable. Vehicle detail lazy chunk keeps a background poll — use wait_until='domcontentloaded' + explicit wait_for_timeout(5-6s) rather than 'networkidle'. PDF generation (html2canvas) takes ~5-15s inside headless — always allow up to 30s for whatsapp-share-message-input readiness. Web Share API is unavailable in headless so whatsapp-share-files-button is intentionally hidden (expected). Console 401s before login and 422/409s during validation/superseded tests are EXPECTED (tests reproducing negative paths).
